messages:
Sofia (CS): Quick debrief from onboarding call with Orbitix. They like throughput but raised 3 items that could affect renewal. dropping raw notes here.
Diego (CSM): TL;DR: finance needs campaign-level cost splits, ops hit duplicate downstream writes from retries, product asks for clearer per-route latency slices. risk: medium.
Sofia (CS): Orbitix asks: 
- request tagging for campaign attribution (header or body) exportable to CSV
- server-side webhook retry with idempotency token + optional DLQ
- route-level latency percentiles (p50/p95) in console/export
Sofia (CS): They shared an example header they send: `X-Campaign-Id: orbit-q3` and a curl snippet they used when they saw duplicates.
Diego (CSM): they run 4 routes in production: scoring, enrich, embeddings, notify. scoring has duplicates when client retries on 502.
Rina (PM): useful. which of these is fastest to ship as a relief?
Kai (Eng): cheapest path = header passthrough and include campaign field in usage export CSV. telemetry change + export mapping ~1 sprint. per-route percentiles can reuse metrics infra ~1 sprint. server-side retries + idempotency + DLQ is heavier ~2-3 sprints.
Diego (CSM): customer priority order = billing exports (CFO), retry safeties (ops), then metrics (product). if we do the export MVP quickly it eases CFO pressure.
Sofia (CS): Action: I'll create a ticket with acceptance criteria and sample CSV mapping. need agreement on header name (they prefer `X-Campaign-Id`).
SupportBot: created RW-7010 "campaign-tag export MVP" assigned to Product; https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-7010 :white_check_mark:
Rina (PM): Kai, can you add a short note in RW-7010 describing the data pipeline change and sample CSV columns by Wed EOD? that'll let CS validate with customer finance.
Kai (Eng): will add note + sample rows. also drafting constraints for idempotency header format and DLQ semantics in a separate ticket RW-7011.
Diego (CSM): I'll tell Orbitix we can prioritize campaign tagging this sprint and follow up on retries scope.
Sofia (CS): closing loop for now  I'll post updates after the ticket is fleshed out and after sprint planning. thanks team.
